كَتِيبَةٌ see كِتَابٌ. ＝
-A2- An army; a military force: (S, K:) or a collected portion thereof; (Msb;) [a body of troops; a corps:] or a troop: or a troop of horse making a hostile attack or incursion, in number from a hundred to a thousand: (K:) pl. كَتَائِبُ. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
